user.title: Base Power
user.description: How would you like to sign in?

menu_options.email: Sign in with an emailed code
menu_options.manual: Paste a credential from the browser (advanced)

email.title: Sign in to Base Power
email.description: Base Power has no password. Enter the email address on your Base account and they will send you a six-digit code.

code.title: Enter your code
code.description: Base Power emailed a six-digit code to {email}. It expires after a few minutes.

manual.title: Paste a credential
manual.description: Only needed if the emailed code does not work: for example an account that signs in with Google or Apple, or one with two-factor authentication. Sign in at {url}, then copy the value of the `__client` cookie for that site (DevTools > Application > Cookies). Use `__client`, not `__session`: the latter expires after about a minute.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Base Power again
reauth_confirm.description: The stored credential is no longer accepted, which happens when the Base Power session ends or is revoked. Continue and a fresh code will be emailed to {email}.

error.unknown_email: No Base Power account was found for that email address.
error.invalid_code: That code was not correct. Check the email and try again; the code is still valid.
error.code_expired: That code has expired or has been tried too many times. Start again to get a new one.
error.too_many_requests: Base Power is temporarily refusing sign-in attempts for this account. Wait a few minutes before trying again.
error.signin_failed: Sign-in could not be completed. If this account uses Google, Apple or two-factor authentication, go back and use the paste option instead.
error.invalid_auth: Base Power rejected that credential. Check it was copied whole, and that it is the `__client` cookie rather than `__session`.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Base Power API.
error.no_locations: That account signed in, but has no sites on it.

abort.already_configured: That site is already set up.
abort.reauth_successful: Base Power was signed in again.

auth_failed.message: Base Power rejected the stored credential, so Home Assistant has been signed out. Sign in again to reconnect. ({error})

api_error.message: Could not read the battery from Base Power: {error}

telemetry_unavailable.title: {name} is not sending data
telemetry_unavailable.description:
Your backup is not affected. In a grid outage the battery will still power your home, even while it is not reporting.

Base Power reports that your battery is not currently sending data, and Base's own app shows the same thing.

Check the battery's Wi-Fi first. Over Wi-Fi it reports about every 32 seconds. On a cellular fallback it reports far less often, and Base drops a reading once it goes stale, which looks exactly like this. Repeated or long gaps usually mean the battery is on cellular. Check the access point it connects to: the one real occurrence was a power injector unplugged at the network end, leaving the access point looking powered while carrying no traffic.

The battery's sensors show unavailable and the battery state sensor reads Telemetry unavailable. That is deliberate. There is no current reading, and showing the last known value would look like a real measurement.

Home Assistant cannot fix this. The gap is between the battery and Base. The connection from Home Assistant to Base is working, which is how this was detected. If the Wi-Fi is fine and it does not clear, contact Base Support.

This notice clears by itself as soon as the battery starts reporting again.

init.title: Base Power options
init.description: How often to poll. The mobile app refreshes every second, but only while its screen is open; Home Assistant polls continuously, so the default is 30 seconds.
